R226.note: Type-asserts *jwt.SigningMethodHMAC in keyFunc before returning the secret, the canonical golang-jwt method pin; nothing else changes (explanation's attack narrative is muddled but the code is right).

R227.note: headerLen > UINT32_MAX - payloadLen is a correct non-wrapping overflow guard before the sum; the new nullptr return only fires on inputs that previously caused an undersized allocation and is stated in the write-up.

R228.note: Owner/admin check shape is right but identity comes from a client-settable x-user-id metadata header, so any caller can impersonate an admin; the interceptor is also dead code because the hand-written MethodDesc handler ignores its interceptor argument; the fix invents users.is_admin/projects.owner_id schema whose absence would fail every delete with Internal, only partly acknowledged as an example.

R229.note: Pins { algorithms: ['RS256'] } on jwt.verify, the documented jsonwebtoken fix; error handling and response shape unchanged.

R230.note: Named parameter :searchPattern bound via setParameter with the wildcards folded into the value; query semantics (including LIKE metacharacter behaviour) identical to the original.

R231.note: Sends SET as a length-prefixed RESP array so CRLF/spaces in key or bio are data; response read and return value unchanged.

R232.note: JavaScriptEncoder.Default.Encode inside the JS string literal is the correct context encoder; Razor's subsequent HTML-encoding has nothing left to touch since HTML-sensitive characters are already \uXXXX, and title, label exposure and numeric refreshSeconds are preserved per the contract.

R233.note: Build FAIL: dummyHash is declared string but bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword returns []byte, so the fix does not compile; the migration to bcrypt-hashed storage and the dummy-hash path are stated openly, but nothing ships.

R234.note: Swapping Roslyn compilation for DynamicExpresso with reflection off closes arbitrary code execution, but it changes the public method signature and rejects every existing rule (C# classes with Evaluate) in favour of expressions - a stated redesign that stops current legitimate use.

R235.note: Drops the is_staff widening so get_queryset always filters by owner, which is exactly the policy the viewset docstring and IsTicketOwner state; staff losing the list view is the contract, and the write-up says so.

R236.note: ODBC positional ? placeholder with the value bound via Parameters.AddWithValue and wildcards inside the value; result formatting and LIKE semantics unchanged.

R237.note: Explicit antiforgery.ValidateRequestAsync before the state change is the documented path for JSON-bound minimal API endpoints the middleware does not auto-validate; the token-header requirement on legitimate clients is inherent and stated, though the write-up's claim of a 400 is off (an uncaught AntiforgeryValidationException surfaces as 500).

R238.note: HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode on banner.Message at the HTML text sink, the only untrusted field; markup and timestamp output unchanged.

R239.note: WebUtility.HtmlEncode on both query values at the point of insertion into HTML text; null query values still render as empty, so output is otherwise identical.
